data.description:
Add the core built-in criterion T15 "overlay-derisk" to the plan-review registry. Stack-agnostic; routed by the self-gating Pass-1 finder (no ticket-tag routing) exactly like the other Txx overlays.

## Work
- New rubric: src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T15.md (YAML front-matter: category plan-review-criterion, execution_mode AGENT, dimension empirical/approach-soundness) with the S1-S3 applicability gate and checks (a)-(d) as finalized in the parent epic description.
- Routing entry: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json for T15 (exec AGENT, facet, applies_at). Do NOT set posture/threshold beyond the registry default; advisory-vs-blocking is decided by the normal process, not this ticket.
- Register the id: add "T15" to CANONICAL_LLM in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py.
- Regenerate the generated guide: python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide (updates docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md).

## Acceptance criteria
- `rebar explain T15` renders the criterion name, exec tier, facet, and rubric body.
- check_registry_coverage / validate_routing / validate_criteria_guide pass (every canonical id has a loadable prompt + routing entry, no orphans).
- docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md contains a generated "## T15" section matching the rubric.
- A plan describing standing up a new deployed service triggers T15 via the finder; an app-only/library plan yields PASS not-applicable (covered by the eval-fixtures child).
data.title: Add T15 overlay-derisk criterion: rubric + routing + registry + regenerate guide
